gaps.sentence: I did it ___ my own initiative — nobody asked me.
gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.

gaps.sentence: ___ second thoughts, maybe we should postpone.
The surgeons operated ___ the light of head-torches when the power failed.
gaps.explanation: 'By the light of' = using the light from something.

gaps.sentence: Everything was left ___ the care of the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: 'in the care of' = looked after by.

gaps.sentence: The letter arrived ___ due course — three weeks later.
gaps.hint: ___ due course = at the expected time
gaps.explanation: 'in due course' = at the proper time eventually.

gaps.sentence: The scheme paid off in the ___ — we recouped every euro.
The play closed after three nights ___ account of poor ticket sales.
gaps.explanation: 'On account of' = because of, in a formal register.

gaps.sentence: ___ the circumstances, the committee chose leniency.
